Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 24
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misaddressed a web-browsing instruction to the Assistant (“WebSurfer, please search…”) instead of to WebSurfer, stalling the data-gathering flow. This coordination error compounded into never assembling the full list of Fidelity EM equity NTF funds or computing May 2019–May 2024 changes, yet the Orchestrator still concluded with FEMKX as the final answer without evidence—directly causing the wrong solution.
